name: cilia and flagella associated protein 44

function.text: CFAP44 is the approved symbol for cilia and flagella associated protein 44. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in peptidase activity; microtubule cytoskeleton organization; sperm axoneme assembly.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Clear cell renal cell carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.

selection_reason: Added to ensure complete representation of genes in the three Cancer Hotspots original release workbooks.

function.text: CFAP44 encodes cilia and flagella associated protein 44. Its functions include peptidase activity and microtubule cytoskeleton organization.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CFAP44 have been reported in clear cell renal cell carcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
